change: Check the current vtable for an ObjectModel layout before allocating cycle-detection storage for parent traversal.

contract.before: Look up the current vtable; root it and insert it into a visited set; select its current layout; follow parents with cycle checks until a layout is found.
contract.after: Look up and root the current vtable; select its current layout; if none exists, start the visited set and follow the same live parents with cycle checks.
preserved: Same vtable lookup, layout queries, identity validation and parent messages in the same order.
Each visited vtable is rooted before callbacks that inspect its layout. The visited set still terminates cycles before querying a repeated layout.
Selected layout snapshots remain owned copies across callbacks and replacement. No cache, cross-owner read or Id change.

microbenchmark.scope: Existing ObjectModel slotKindOf:at: and slotAt:in: through Id, layout lengths 0 and 8. Direct layout reads and slot access with 0, 1 or 16 parent traversals. Serial ABBA, seven samples/process. Automatic GC policy unchanged; precise GC outside samples. Every result checked.

full_collection.scope: Full precise collection after 1000 Integer/Range iterations; automatic GC disabled only while producing garbage, same policy in both lanes. Twelve collection timings per variant, four fresh processes, ABBA then BAAB. Successful nonempty collections checked.

validation: object_model, object_model_slots and object_model_scopes passed against the final candidate.
New live-parent cycle/early-layout checks also passed against the baseline; existing replacement, failure, rooting and collection tests retained.

scripts/oop-id-slice-test.sh passed: owner unit tests, compiler/GC smoke, construction and direct-dispatch contracts, export audit, cross-thread rejection, independent C cold caller and finalizer containment.
contract_review: Only host-side visited-set work moved. Initial null vtables still return no layout. The direct-layout path roots the same vtable before identity validation. Parent paths root each newly visited vtable before layout inspection and reject a repeated vtable without another layout callback. The old path briefly appended a duplicate root on cycle detection; no callback could observe that append before scope cleanup.

rejected_experiments.change: Experiment: share immutable Layout byte arrays with Rc instead of cloning a Box.
rejected_experiments.reason: Strong wins on large layout descriptions, but empty descriptions were 2-3% slower and the full-collection probes showed no measurable improvement. Prefer eliminating unnecessary traversal bookkeeping first.

rejected_experiments.change: Cycle membership check followed by insertion on each parent step.
rejected_experiments.reason: Direct slot reads improved but a 16-parent chain regressed by about 15%.

rejected_experiments.change: Seed the visited set conditionally inside each loop iteration.
rejected_experiments.reason: Removed duplicate hashing but still regressed a 16-parent chain by 6-8%.

limits: Controlled substitution of only libbirnam_object_model.dylib across 783 files; not a fresh installed release. User installation unchanged.
The clear gain is direct slot access, about 13-14% less CPU for empty and eight-slot descriptions. Inherited access varied by roughly 0-3%; no inherited-access speedup claimed.
Full-collection process variance is material; report its measurements separately from the direct-slot improvement. No application-wide speedup established.

Slot microbenchmarks preserve automatic GC and time every checked query; explicit collection and construction are outside those timers. Full-collection probes disable automatic GC only while producing garbage, then time explicit collection. Production GC policy unchanged.
decision: Retained for the direct-slot improvement; the expanded full-collection comparison is effectively neutral (-1.27% Integer, +0.08% Range) relative to observed process variation. Do not claim a general GC speedup.
